experiment_data.hypothesis: Reverse cutoff (no occ_loss first 35K steps, then enable occ_loss from 35K to 50K) tests whether late-stage gradient flow alone is sufficient for collision avoidance. Combined with standard cutoff (occ_loss first 35K only), forms a 2x2 temporal design isolating when gradient flow matters most.
